items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Men like Damian Moon... Moon didn't miss nothin'. He could read anything you put up there.

ctx.x: But you said a lot of these men who were in the band now had come out of dancing schools or taxi dance halls...
Yes, they could read. Men like Damian Moon... Moon didn't miss nothin'. He could read anything you put up there.
And Greely was a good reader.
